SMTO-GWT-0004 — SMTO couldn't tell what system the Gateway computer runs

GUID: 7713db0d-0a2b-40bf-87f3-13e71719cfbd
Slug: gateway-platform-unknown
Domain: GWT · Subsystem: gateway

What happened

  • The computer's Gateway didn't tell SMTO which operating system it runs, so SMTO couldn't use it for this work. The saved message doesn't say exactly why.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open Settings › Setup › Gateways and select Check connection on that Gateway's row. A fresh check asks the Gateway to report its system again.
  2. Look under the Gateway's name. If the system type shows Unknown, expand the row and select Check for updates in Software updates. An older Gateway may not report its system in a way this SMTO understands.
  3. If an update is offered, select the Update to button and confirm, after any running work on that computer has finished. Updating restarts the Gateway and stops its running work, so do it at a quiet time.
  4. When the row shows Connected and a system type, run the task again. SMTO can only choose the right commands once it knows the computer's system.

What success looks like

  • The Gateway's row shows Connected with its operating system named, and the task runs.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages that computer. Don't keep resending the task unchanged while the system still shows Unknown.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A saved error records that the connected Gateway reported no supported platform; no current code path produces it, so the missing or unsupported field is not identified.

What this means

  • This retained compatibility category indicates an unknown Gateway platform; no current direct producer establishes which metadata field was absent or unsupported. This compatibility identity remains supported, but its absent direct producer limits causal claims. No new probe or inference is part of rendering this explanation.

  • Inspect the retained occurrence and current supported Gateway metadata before attributing this to an old installation.

How to fix it

  • Run a health check and inspect the record's platform, platform_label and Gateway version in the capability snapshot. If the platform is absent or unsupported, update the Gateway to a release compatible with this Server; this compatibility code has no current direct producer, so treat older stored errors as historical.
  • Inspect the selected Gateway's reported platform and version. Update only if its actual compatibility requirements demand it.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • The intended Gateway reports a supported platform and the affected operation accepts its profile.

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.
